## Changelog

## Downloads
Below you can find the binary assets for Linux, Windows, and macOS.

## Installation Notes
- **Linux:** Download the `.AppImage` or `.deb`. 
- **Windows:** You may see a SmartScreen or Smart App Control warning. This is expected as the binary is currently unsigned. We are working on obtaining a signature. See [SIGNING.md](https://github.com/sanromarth/ornas/blob/main/SIGNING.md) for details.
- **macOS:** You may see an Apple Gatekeeper warning because the application is not yet notarized. See [SIGNING.md](https://github.com/sanromarth/ornas/blob/main/SIGNING.md) for details.
